observations: Photo 0 shows two car headlights, one larger and one smaller, both with black housings, clear lenses, and orange turn signal sections. They are placed on plastic wrap on a concrete surface.

Photo 1 shows the front of a car with the hood open. One headlight is installed, and the other is placed on the engine bay. The installed headlight has a different design: it is more rectangular with a clear lens and a visible projector lens, while the one on the engine bay matches the design in photo 0.
The headlight on the engine bay in photo 1 has a black housing, a circular projector lens, and an orange turn signal section — matching the larger headlight in photo 0.
The installed headlight in photo 1 is different in design: it has a more traditional rectangular shape with a different internal structure, suggesting it is not the same model as the one being sold.
No brand or model markings are visible on the headlights in either photo.
The seller claims the headlights are '1 month neatly used without any fault'.

claims.claim: 1 month neatly used without any fault
claims.evidence: No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos, but there is no proof of functionality or actual usage duration. The installed headlight in photo 1 is different, suggesting the item may not be as described.

risks.risk: The headlights may not work or may have hidden electrical faults.

risks.risk: The headlights may be mismatched or not a pair (e.g., one is for left, one for right, but not confirmed).
risks.proof: A clear side-by-side photo showing both headlights from the same angle, with mounting points and orientation clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as mismatched or incomplete pair

proof_requests: A clear photo or video showing both headlights installed on a car, with all lights functioning.
A close-up photo of the mounting points and connectors to confirm compatibility with the buyer's vehicle.
A photo showing the brand or model markings, if any, on the headlights.
response.reason: The headlights are not identifiable by brand or model, and the seller's claim of '1 month neatly used without any fault' cannot be verified from the photos. The installed headlight in photo 1 is different from the ones being sold, raising compatibility concerns. Proof of functionality, compatibility, and matching pair is needed before pricing.
